instruction: Using command line tools, split the tilearray.png image horizontally into two equal halves and save the bottom half as "bottom_half.png" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires splitting tilearray.png (962x1280) horizontally into two halves and saving the bottom half. The bottom half should be 962 pixels wide (same as original) and 640 pixels tall (1280/2). Verified with Python: original image is 962x1280, so bottom half is 962x640.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE COVERAGE: Evaluator verifies both dimensions (962x640) AND pixel content of the saved image
Correct getter logic: Retrieves both the original tilearray.png and result bottom_half.png, crops the original to extract expected bottom half (lines 93-97 in getters/image.py)
Correct metric logic: Compares pixel content using MSE-based similarity (lines 98-103 in metrics/image.py), not just dimensions
Proper verification: Returns 1.0 only if similarity >= 0.95, ensuring the saved image actually contains the bottom half content, not just matching dimensions
Good edge case handling: Checks for missing files, dimension mismatches, and shape mismatches before comparison
Appropriate tolerance: 0.95 similarity threshold allows for minor compression artifacts while ensuring correctness
